topic: Strict freshness with one-front GitHub auto-merge
context: ADR-094. User-owned repository without native merge queue. Trunk removed. Parallel refresh of 41 branches triggered 820 workflow runs and 818 cancellations.

votes.rationale: Strict provides the safety lock; one-front controls CI cost.
Final model closes prior TOCTOU and parallel-cost findings.
Cost model and stacked PR guidance are correctly scoped.
GitHub enforces freshness server-side with no bypass language.
Live strict state and commands are verifiable.
Minimum mechanism with no custom queue or daemon.
